name: data-table
title: Data Table
description: An MRT-complete data table for shadcn/ui (TanStack Table v9): sorting, filtering, search, grouping, editing, pinning, virtualization, export and more.

"use client"

"use client" import type { RowData } from "@tanstack/react-table" import { DataTableFilterModeMenu } from "../menus/data-table-filter-mode-menu" import { AutocompleteFilterField, CheckboxFilterField, DateFilterField, DateRangeFilterField, DateTimeFilterField, MultiSelectFilterField, NumberFilterField, RangeSliderFilterField, SelectFilterField, TextFilterField, type FilterFieldProps, } from "./filter-variants" import type { DataTableInstance } from "../../core/types" import type { DataTableHeader } from "../../core/table-types" interface DataTableColumnFilterProps { header: DataTableHeader table: DataTableInstance } /** * One filter-row field. Reads `column.meta.filterVariant` and renders the matching * control, preceded by the filter-mode menu (where the variant supports modes). * `meta.renderColumnFilter` is an escape hatch for fully custom UI. Returns an * empty placeholder for non-filterable columns so the grid stays aligned. */ export function DataTableColumnFilter({ header, table, }: DataTableColumnFilterProps) { const { column } = header if (header.isPlaceholder || !column.getCanFilter()) { return
} const custom = column.columnDef.meta?.renderColumnFilter if (custom) { return <>{custom({ column, table })} } return (
) } function FilterField({ column, table, }: FilterFieldProps) { const variant = column.columnDef.meta?.filterVariant ?? "text" switch (variant) { case "select": return case "multi-select": return case "checkbox": return case "range": return case "range-slider": return case "date": return case "date-range": return case "datetime": case "datetime-range": return ( ) case "time": case "time-range": return case "autocomplete": return default: return } }

/** Any component that renders an icon and accepts a `className`. */
export type IconComponent = React.ComponentType<{ className?: string }>

/**
 * Every icon the data table renders, by semantic name. Defaults are Lucide
 * (shadcn's default icon library). Override any subset via
 * `useDataTable({ icons: { … } })` to swap icon libraries or individual glyphs
 * (MRT's `icons` prop equivalent). Selection checkboxes and calendar internals
 * come from the shadcn primitives and are out of scope here.
 */
export interface DataTableIcons {
  /** Header sort indicator: sorted ascending. */
  sortAscending: IconComponent
  /** Header sort indicator: sorted descending. */
  sortDescending: IconComponent
  /** Header sort indicator: sortable but not sorted. */
  sortUnsorted: IconComponent
  /** Column-actions menu trigger in each header. */
  columnActions: IconComponent
  /** Filter toggle and filter menu items. */
  filter: IconComponent
  /** Hide-filters state of the filter toggle and clear-filter items. */
  filterOff: IconComponent
  /** Advanced filter panel toggle. */
  advancedFilter: IconComponent
  /** Clear-sort / show-all reset action. */
  clearAll: IconComponent
  /** Hide-column menu item. */
  hide: IconComponent
  /** Pin column and pin row actions. */
  pin: IconComponent
  /** Shown on a pinned row's pin button. */
  pinnedRow: IconComponent
  /** Unpin column and unpin row actions. */
  unpin: IconComponent
  /** Group-by menu item and grouping chips. */
  group: IconComponent
  /** Column-visibility (show/hide columns) toolbar button. */
  columnVisibility: IconComponent
  /** Density toggle toolbar button. */
  density: IconComponent
  /** Full-screen toggle while not full screen. */
  fullscreenEnter: IconComponent
  /** Full-screen toggle while full screen. */
  fullscreenExit: IconComponent
  /** Global search button and search-mode menu. */
  search: IconComponent
  /** Clear buttons (search box, filter inputs, grouping chips). */
  clear: IconComponent
  /** Pagination: first page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. */
  pageFirst: IconComponent
  /** Pagination: previous page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. */
  pagePrev: IconComponent
  /** Pagination: next page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. */
  pageNext: IconComponent
  /** Pagination: last page. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. */
  pageLast: IconComponent
  /** Expand control of an expanded row or group. */
  expanded: IconComponent
  /** Expand control of a collapsed row or group. Mirrored in right-to-left tables. */
  collapsed: IconComponent
  /** Drag grip for column and row reordering. */
  dragHandle: IconComponent
  /** Edit row / edit cell action. */
  edit: IconComponent
  /** Copy action in the cell menu. */
  copy: IconComponent
  /** Save action while editing a row. */
  save: IconComponent
  /** Cancel action while editing a row. */
  cancel: IconComponent
  /** Date filter field trigger. */
  calendar: IconComponent
}

/**
 * Localization string table for the data table. Every user-facing string
 * (labels, aria text, pagination range) flows through here so the table can be
 * fully translated. Function-valued entries handle interpolation/plurals.

 * Default is English. Override per instance via `useDataTable({ localization })`.
 */
export interface DataTableLocalization {
  // Language
  /**
   * BCP 47 tag used to format dates (e.g. "en", "de"). Numbers are formatted
   * by the function keys of each localization, with that file's own tag.

  // Selection
  selectAll: string
  selectRow: string
  clearSelection: string

  // Sorting
  sortByColumnAsc: (column: string) => string

  // Filtering

  showColumnFilters: string
  hideColumnFilters: string
  min: string

  pickDateRange: string

  // Advanced filter panel
  advancedFilters: string
  /** The "Match All/Any of the following rules" sentence; `logic` marks where
   *  the All/Any picker goes, so each language can order the words. */
  advancedFiltersMatch: (logic: string) => string
  advancedFiltersMatchAll: string
  advancedFiltersMatchAny: string
  advancedFiltersAddRule: string
  advancedFiltersApply: string
  advancedFiltersClearAll: string
  advancedFiltersColumn: string
  advancedFiltersOperator: string
  advancedFiltersValue: string
  advancedFiltersEmpty: string
  removeFilterRule: string
  /** Operator labels, keyed by `AdvancedFilterOperator`. */
  advancedFilterOperators: Record<string, string>

  // Global search
  search: string
  searchPlaceholder: string
  clearSearch: string
  globalFilterMode: string

  // Density
  toggleDensity: string
  densityComfortable: string
  densityCompact: string
  densitySpacious: string

  // Full screen
  enterFullscreen: string
  exitFullscreen: string

  // Pagination
  rowsPerPage: string
  paginationRange: (start: number, end: number, total: number) => string
  goToFirstPage: string
  goToPreviousPage: string
  goToNextPage: string
  goToLastPage: string
  goToPage: (page: number) => string

  // Editing / actions
  rowActions: string
  edit: string
  save: string
  cancel: string
  delete: string
  create: string
  createNewRow: string
  editRow: string
  required: string
  copy: string
  copied: string
  cellActions: string

  // Empty / loading
  noRecordsToDisplay: string
  /** Shown instead of `noRecordsToDisplay` when filters or the search hide
   *  every row. */
  noResultsFound: string
  /** Labels for aggregation function names, shown when a column lists several
   *  (`aggregationFn: ["sum", "mean"]`). Merged with the English defaults by
   *  key; unknown names show as written. */
  aggregationFns?: Record<string, string>
  loading: string
  loadingMore: string

  // Drag and drop (screen readers)
  dragStart: (label: string) => string
  dragOver: (label: string, over: string) => string
  dragEnd: (label: string, over: string) => string
  dragCancel: (label: string) => string
  dragInstructions: string
  dragRowLabel: (position: number) => string
}

import type {
  AggregationFnDef,
  Cell,
  CellData,
  Column,
  ColumnDef,
  FilterFn,
  Header,
  HeaderGroup,
  Row,
  RowData,
  RowModel,
  SortFn,
  Table,
} from "@tanstack/react-table"

import type { DataTableFeatures } from "./features"

// Our names for TanStack's generic types. This file is the only place that
// knows TanStack's generic arity (v9 adds the feature-set parameter), so
// consumers type columns with `DataTableColumnDef<TData>` and never see it.

export type { DataTableFeatures } from "./features"

export type DataTableColumnDef<
  TData extends RowData,
  TValue extends CellData = CellData,
> = ColumnDef<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>

export type DataTableRow<TData extends RowData> = Row<DataTableFeatures, TData>

export type DataTableColumn<
  TData extends RowData,
  TValue extends CellData = CellData,
> = Column<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>

export type DataTableCell<
  TData extends RowData,
  TValue extends CellData = CellData,
> = Cell<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>

export type DataTableHeader<
  TData extends RowData,
  TValue extends CellData = CellData,
> = Header<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>

export type DataTableHeaderGroup<TData extends RowData> = HeaderGroup<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData
>

/** The raw TanStack table (no `dataTable` config attached). */
export type DataTableCoreTable<TData extends RowData> = Table<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData
>

export type DataTableRowModel<TData extends RowData> = RowModel<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData
>

export type DataTableFilterFn<TData extends RowData> = FilterFn<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData
>

export type DataTableSortFn<TData extends RowData> = SortFn<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData
>

/** An aggregation function: `aggregate` the rows (and optionally `merge`
 *  sub-group results). The result type is up to you. */
export type DataTableAggregationFn<TData extends RowData> = AggregationFnDef<
  DataTableFeatures,
  TData,
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  any,
  // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
  any
>

/** A row-model factory: called once per table, returns the memoized getter. */
export type DataTableRowModelFactory<TData extends RowData> = (
  table: DataTableCoreTable<TData>
) => () => DataTableRowModel<TData>

import type { FilterVariant } from "../core/types"
import type { FilterMode } from "./filter-modes"

/** Default mode for a variant when the consumer hasn't chosen one. */
export function defaultModeForVariant(variant: FilterVariant): FilterMode {
  switch (variant) {
    case "range":
    case "range-slider":
      // Inclusive, like MRT: a slider at [min, x] must keep rows equal to min.
      return "betweenInclusive"
    case "date":
    case "datetime":
    case "time":
      return "equals"
    case "date-range":
    case "datetime-range":
    case "time-range":
      return "betweenDates"
    case "select":
      return "equalsString"
    case "multi-select":
      return "arrIncludesSome"
    case "checkbox":
      return "equalsBool"
    default:
      return "contains"
  }
}

/** Modes offered in the mode menu per variant. Empty array → no mode menu. */
export function modeOptionsForVariant(variant: FilterVariant): FilterMode[] {
  switch (variant) {
    case "text":
    case "autocomplete":
      return [
        "fuzzy",
        "contains",
        "startsWith",
        "endsWith",
        "equals",
        "notEquals",
        "empty",
        "notEmpty",
      ]
    case "range":
    case "range-slider":
      return [
        "betweenInclusive",
        "between",
        "equals",
        "notEquals",
        "greaterThan",
        "greaterThanOrEqualTo",
        "lessThan",
        "lessThanOrEqualTo",
        "empty",
        "notEmpty",
      ]
    case "date":
    case "date-range":
    case "datetime":
    case "datetime-range":
    case "time":
    case "time-range":
      return [
        "equals",
        "notEquals",
        "before",
        "after",
        "betweenDates",
        "empty",
        "notEmpty",
      ]
    default:
      // select / multi-select / checkbox have a single fixed mode
      return []
  }
}

"use client"

// Public API — the data table, its hook, config plumbing, documented helpers,
// and the types describing them. The engine and shared definitions live under
// ./core; the supporting building blocks live under ./components, ./hooks,
// ./fns, and ./utils and are intentionally not all re-exported here.

"use client" import type { RowData } from "@tanstack/react-table" import type { DataTableIcons } from "../core/icons" import type { DataTableLocalization } from "../core/localization" import type { DataTableColumnDef } from "../core/table-types" import { RowPinButton } from "./row-pin-button" export const ROW_PIN_COLUMN_ID = "cn-row-pin" /** Standalone pin column, injected when `enableRowPinning` is on but * `enableRowNumbers` is off (otherwise the pin lives in the number column). */ export function createRowPinColumn( localization: DataTableLocalization, icons: DataTableIcons ): DataTableColumnDef { return { id: ROW_PIN_COLUMN_ID, enableSorting: false, enableHiding: false, enableColumnFilter: false, enableResizing: false, enableGrouping: false, size: 40, minSize: 40, meta: { enableColumnActions: false, align: "center" }, header: () => {localization.pinRow}, cell: ({ row }) => ( ), } }
